article.headline: Mitchell, Cavaliers to host Antetokounmpo and the Heat
article.description: Miami Heat (11-7, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Cleveland Cavaliers (9-10, seventh in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Mitchell, Cavaliers to host Antetokounmpo and the Heat
article.linkText: Mitchell, Cavaliers to host Antetokounmpo and the Heat
article.story: Miami Heat (11-7, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Cleveland Cavaliers (9-10, seventh in the Eastern Conference) Cleveland; Sunday, 3:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Cleveland takes on Miami in a matchup of Eastern Conference teams. The Cavaliers are 7-7 in Eastern Conference games. Cleveland ranks ninth in the Eastern Conference with 11.3 offensive rebounds per game led by Jarrett Allen averaging 2.6. The Heat are 6-3 in Eastern Conference play. Miami ranks eighth in the Eastern Conference shooting 34.3% from 3-point range. The Cavaliers are shooting 47.1% from the field this season, 0.5 percentage points lower than the 47.6% the Heat allow to opponents. The Heat are shooting 47.3% from the field, 1.4% higher than the 45.9% the Cavaliers' opponents have shot this season. The teams square off for the second time this season. In the last matchup on Nov. 14 the Heat won 133-121 led by 37 points from Giannis Antetokounmpo, while Donovan Mitchell scored 25 points for the Cavaliers. TOP PERFORMERS: Mitchell is averaging 25 points and 5.1 assists for the Cavaliers. James Harden is averaging 19.3 points over the last 10 games. Antetokounmpo is averaging 28.1 points, 13.3 rebounds and 5.2 assists for the Heat. Klay Thompson is averaging 3.2 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Cavaliers: 4-6, averaging 115.7 points, 42.2 rebounds, 25.9 assists, 7.2 steals and 5.2 blocks per game while shooting 47.9% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 119.1 points per game. Heat: 8-2, averaging 119.9 points, 42.2 rebounds, 28.8 assists, 7.8 steals and 5.7 blocks per game while shooting 47.4% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 114.4 points. INJURIES: Cavaliers: Nae'Qwan Tomlin: out (back), Evan Mobley: out (toe). Heat: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
